snippets.title: Avone - Re-render & mở Cart Drawer sau Add to Cart
snippets.description: Lắng nghe teeinblue-event-after-cart-added, gọi /cart/update.js và renderContents của cart-drawer trên theme Avone.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', function () {
  window.forceReloadCartDrawer = function () {
    const cartDrawer = document.querySelector('cart-drawer');
    if (!cartDrawer) return;
    const sectionsToRender = cartDrawer.getSectionsToRender().map(s => s.id);
    fetch(window.routes?.cart_update_url || '/cart/update.js', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/javascript' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ sections: sectionsToRender })
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(state => {
      cartDrawer.renderContents(state);
      cartDrawer.open();
    })
    .catch(console.error);
  };
  window.forceReloadCartDrawer();
});
</script>

snippets.title: Corner Stone - Quick Cart Drawer & Cart Icon Header
snippets.description: Cập nhật Quick Cart Drawer và icon cart ở header (cả Desktop & Mobile) sau khi add to cart theme Corner Stone.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', function () {
  fetch(window.location.href)
    .then(response => response.text())
    .then(html => {
      const parser = new DOMParser();
      const doc = parser.parseFromString(html, 'text/html');

      // 1. Cart Drawer (Quick Cart)
      const newDrawer = doc.querySelector('.quick-cart, #quick-cart, [data-quick-cart]');
      const currentDrawer = document.querySelector('.quick-cart, #quick-cart, [data-quick-cart]');
      if (newDrawer && currentDrawer) {
        currentDrawer.innerHTML = newDrawer.innerHTML;
      }

      // 2. Icon Cart on Header (Desktop & Mobile)
      const newCartCount = doc.querySelector('.cart-count, [data-cart-count], .cart-link__bubble');
      const currentCartCount = document.querySelector('.cart-count, [data-cart-count], .cart-link__bubble');
      if (newCartCount && currentCartCount) {
        currentCartCount.innerHTML = newCartCount.innerHTML;
        currentCartCount.classList.remove('hide', 'hidden');
      }

      // Mở Drawer nếu có method
      if (typeof theme !== 'undefined' && theme.cart && typeof theme.cart.open === 'function') {
        theme.cart.open();
      } else if (typeof window.openQuickCart === 'function') {
        window.openQuickCart();
      }
    })
    .catch(error => console.error('Error updating cart:', error));
});
</script>

snippets.title: Eurus - Re-render & mở Cart Drawer sau Add to Cart
snippets.description: Fetch sections cart-drawer & cart-icon-bubble, gọi renderContents và dispatch event mở drawer theme Eurus.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', () => {
  const drawer = document.querySelector('cart-drawer');
  if (drawer) {
    fetch(window.location.pathname + '?sections=cart-drawer,cart-icon-bubble')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(res => {
        drawer.renderContents({ sections: res });
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('eurus:cart-drawer:open'));
      });
    if (drawer.classList.contains('is-empty')) drawer.classList.remove('is-empty');
  }
});
</script>

snippets.title: Horizon & Vessel - Deferred Event Promise CartDrawerComponent
snippets.description: Dispatch deferred event promise theo chuẩn CartDrawerComponent của Horizon & Vessel để re-render chính xác.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', function () {
  let resolvePromise;
  const cartPromise = new Promise((resolve) => { resolvePromise = resolve; });
  const event = new CustomEvent('cart-item:add:finished', {
    bubbles: true,
    detail: { cart: cartPromise }
  });
  document.dispatchEvent(event);
  fetch('/cart.js')
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(cartData => { resolvePromise(cartData); })
    .catch(error => console.error('Error fetching cart:', error));
});
</script>

snippets.title: Kalles - Update Header Cart Count & Slide Cart
snippets.description: Cập nhật cart count badge và trigger slide cart của theme Kalles.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', function () {
  if (window.location.pathname.indexOf('/cart') === -1) {
    fetch('/cart.js')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(cart => {
        const cartCounts = document.querySelectorAll('.t4s-cart-count, .cart-count');
        cartCounts.forEach(el => { el.textContent = cart.item_count; });
        document.documentElement.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cart:refresh', { bubbles: true }));
      });
  }
});
</script>

snippets.title: Sleek - Render Sections Cart Drawer
snippets.description: Fetch cart-drawer section và render vào cart-drawer của Sleek theme.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', async function () {
  const drawer = document.querySelector('cart-drawer');
  if (drawer && typeof drawer.renderContents === 'function') {
    const res = await fetch(window.location.pathname + '?sections=cart-drawer').then(r => r.json());
    drawer.renderContents({ sections: res });
    drawer.open && drawer.open();
  }
});
</script>

snippets.title: SlideCartHQ - Integration & Cart Refresh
snippets.description: MutationObserver để theo dõi overlay SlideCartHQ và kích hoạt cập nhật giỏ hàng sau khi add to cart.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-component-injected', () => {
  const bodyObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
    const overlay = document.querySelector('#slidecarthq .slidecarthq-overlay');
    if (overlay) {
      bodyObserver.disconnect();
    }
  });
  bodyObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
});
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', () => {
  if (window.SLIDECART && typeof window.SLIDECART.open === 'function') {
    window.SLIDECART.open();
  }
});
</script>

snippets.title: UpCart - Thay thumbnail bằng Customization Image
snippets.description: Cấu hình mapping property thumbnail của Teeinblue sang hình ảnh customization trong UpCart drawer.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', () => {
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.upcart-product-tile, .upcart-item').forEach(tile => {
      const img = tile.querySelector('img');
      const customImg = tile.querySelector('[data-property*="customization_image"], [data-property*="preview"]');
      if (img && customImg && customImg.textContent) {
        img.src = customImg.textContent.trim();
      }
    });
  }, 800);
});
</script>
